newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-VENABLES TO BE AUSTRALIA'S COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VENABLES TO BE AUSTRALIA'S COACH.

text.p: Terry Venables was confirmed on Tuesday as Australia's new soccer coach in their bid for the 1998 World Cup.
The former England boss made the announcement at his night club in west London.
Venables, whose coaching career has included spells at the helm of Barcelona and Tottenham, quit the England job in June after taking his country to the semifinals of Euro 96 on home turf.
He left because of a number of legal battles before him -- including a long-running dispute with Tottenham chairman Alan Sugar.
Venables replaces Eddie Thomson, who is going to work with Hiroshima in Japan's J-League.
